lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬਸੰਤ ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵਹ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat basa(n)t baasudevah paarabraham paramesurah ||
lines.translation: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent, Luminous Lord, dwells in each and every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਚੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੰ ਨਹ ਬਿਸਰੰਤਿ ਨਹ ਬਿਸਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਹ ॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: jaacha(n)t naanak kripaal prasaada(n) nah bisara(n)t nah bisara(n)t naaraainah ||21||
lines.translation: Nanak begs for this blessing from the Merciful Lord, that he may never forget Him, never forget Him. ||21||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਸਮਰਥੰ ਨਹ ਸੇਵਕੰ ਨਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: nah samaratha(n) nah sevaka(n) nah preet param purakhotama(n) ||
lines.translation: I have no power; I do not serve You, and I do not love You, O Supreme Sublime Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਵ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਿਮਰਤੇ ਨਾਮੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੰ ॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: tav prasaad simarate naama(n) naanak kripaal har har gura(n) ||22||
lines.translation: By Your Grace, Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Merciful Lord, Har, Har. ||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਣ ਪੋਖਣ ਕਰੰਤ ਜੀਆ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਛਾਦਨ ਦੇਵੰਤ ਦਾਨੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bharan pokhan kara(n)t jeeaa bisraam chhaadan deva(n)t daana(n) ||
lines.translation: The Lord feeds and sustains all living beings; He blesses them gifts of restful peace and fine clothes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਿਜੰਤ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮ ਚਤੁਰ ਚੇਤਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: srija(n)t ratan janam chatur chetanah ||
lines.translation: He created the jewel of human life, with all its cleverness and intelligence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਰਤੰਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਹ ॥ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥ ਅਨਿਤੵ ਰਚਨਾ ਨਿਰਮੋਹ ਤੇ ॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: varata(n)t sukh aana(n)d prasaadah || simara(n)t naanak har har hare || anity rachanaa niramoh te ||23||
lines.translation: By His Grace, mortals abide in peace and bliss. O Nanak, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har, Haray, The mortal is released from attachment to the world. ||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਨੰ ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬੇਣ ਭੁੰਚੰਤੇ ਮਹੀਪਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: daana(n) paraa pooraben bhu(n)cha(n)te maheepate ||
lines.translation: The kings of the earth are eating up the blessings of the good karma of their past lives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਪਰੀਤ ਬੁਧੵੰ ਮਾਰਤ ਲੋਕਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਦੁਖ ਭੋਗਤੇ ॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: bipareet budhy(n) maarat lokah naanak chira(n)kaal dukh bhogate ||24||
lines.translation: Those cruel-minded rulers who oppress the people, O Nanak, shall suffer in pain for a very long time. ||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਜਸੵ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਰਿਦੰਤਰਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: brithaa anugraha(n) gobi(n)dah jasy simaran rida(n)tarah ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate in remembrance on the Lord in their hearts, look upon even pain as God's Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਰੋਗੵੰ ਮਹਾ ਰੋਗੵੰ ਬਿਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤੇ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮਯਹ ॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: aarogy(n) mahaa rogy(n) bisimrite karunaa mayah ||25||
lines.translation: The healthy person is very sick, if he does not remember the Lord, the Embodiment of Mercy. ||25||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਮਣੰ ਕੇਵਲੰ ਕੀਰਤਨੰ ਸੁਧਰਮੰ ਦੇਹ ਧਾਰਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: ramana(n) kevala(n) keeratana(n) sudharama(n) deh dhaaranah ||
lines.translation: To sing the Kirtan of God's Praises is the righteous duty incurred by taking birth in this human body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੀਵਤੰ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪੵਤੇ ॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam naaraain naanak peevata(n) sa(n)t na tripyte ||26||
lines.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar, O Nanak. The Saints drink it in, and never have enough of it. ||26||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਣ ਸੀਲ ਸੰਤੰ ਸਮ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਸੵ ਦੁਰਜਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahan seel sa(n)ta(n) sam mitrasy durajanah ||
lines.translation: The Saints are tolerant and good-natured; friends and enemies are the same to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੋਜਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੇਣ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਆਵਧ ਹੋਇ ਉਪਤਿਸਟਤੇ ॥੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhojan anik prakaaren ni(n)dak aavadh hoi upatisatate ||27||
lines.translation: O Nanak, it is all the same to them, whether someone offers them all sorts of foods, or slanders them, or draws weapons to kill them. ||27||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਰਸਕਾਰ ਨਹ ਭਵੰਤਿ ਨਹ ਭਵੰਤਿ ਮਾਨ ਭੰਗਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: tirasakaar nah bhava(n)t nah bhava(n)t maan bha(n)ganah ||
lines.translation: They pay no attention to dishonor or disrespect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਭਾ ਹੀਨ ਨਹ ਭਵੰਤਿ ਨਹ ਪੋਹੰਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਦੁਖਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: sobhaa heen nah bhava(n)t nah poha(n)t sa(n)saar dukhanah ||
lines.translation: They are not bothered by gossip; the miseries of the world do not touch them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਜਪੰਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸੁਖ ਬਾਸਨਹ ॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: gobi(n)d naam japa(n)t mil saadh sa(n)gah naanak se praanee sukh baasanah ||28||
lines.translation: Those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and chant the Name of the Lord of the Universe - O Nanak, those mortals abide in peace. ||28||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੈਨਾ ਸਾਧ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੂਰ ਅਜਿਤੰ ਸੰਨਾਹੰ ਤਨਿ ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਾਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: sainaa saadh samooh soor ajita(n) sa(n)naaha(n) tan ni(n)mrataah ||
lines.translation: The Holy people are an invincible army of spiritual warriors; their bodies are protected by the armor of humility.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਧਹ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਮਣੰ ਓਟ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਕਰ ਚਰਮਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavadhah gun gobi(n)d ramana(n) ot gurasabad kar charamanah ||
lines.translation: Their weapons are the Glorious Praises of the Lord which they chant; their Shelter and Shield is the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਰੂੜਤੇ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਰਥ ਨਾਗਹ ਬੁਝੰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਰਗਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: aarooRate asv rath naagah bujha(n)te prabh maaragah ||
lines.translation: The horses, chariots and elephants they ride are their way to realize God's Path.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਚਰਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਯੰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਸੈਨਾ ਧਾਯੰਤੇ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: bicharate nirabhaya(n) satr sainaa dhaaya(n)te goupaal keeratanah ||
lines.translation: They walk fearlessly through the armies of their enemies; they attack them with the Kirtan of God's Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤਤੇ ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਸੰਸਾਰਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਸੵੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰਹ ॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: jitate bisv sa(n)saarah naanak vasy(n) karot pa(n)ch tasakarah ||29||
lines.translation: They conquer the entire world, O Nanak, and overpower the five thieves. ||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਨਗਰੰ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਛਾਯਾ ਰਚਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: mrig trisanaa ga(n)dharab nagara(n) drum chhaayaa rach duramatih ||
lines.translation: Misled by evil-mindedness, mortals are engrossed in the mirage of the illusory world, like the passing shade of a tree.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਤਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਮੋਹ ਮਿਥੵਾ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਹ ॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: tatah kuta(n)b moh mithyaa simara(n)t naanak raam raam naamah ||30||
lines.translation: Emotional attachment to family is false, so Nanak meditates in remembrance on the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam. ||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਚ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਿਗਮੰ ਨਚ ਗੁਣਗੵ ਨਾਮ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: nach bidiaa nidhaan nigama(n) nach gunagy naam keeratanah ||
lines.translation: I do not possess the treasure of the wisdom of the Vedas, nor do I possess the merits of the Praises of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਚ ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਕੰਠੰ ਨਹ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਤੁਰ ਚਾਤੁਰਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: nach raag ratan ka(n)tha(n) nah cha(n)chal chatur chaaturah ||
lines.translation: I do not have a beautiful voice to sing jewelled melodies; I am not clever, wise or shrewd.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਗ ਉਦਿਮ ਲਬਧੵੰ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਖਲ ਪੰਡਿਤਹ ॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhaag udim labadhy(n) maaiaa naanak saadhasa(n)g khal pa(n)ditah ||31||
lines.translation: By destiny and hard work, the wealth of Maya is obtained. O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, even fools become religious scholars. ||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੰਠ ਰਮਣੀਯ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਮਾਲਾ ਹਸਤ ਊਚ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਧਾਰਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ka(n)th ramaneey raam raam maalaa hasat ooch prem dhaaranee ||
lines.translation: The mala around my neck is the chanting of the Lord's Name. The Love of the Lord is my silent chanting.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਹ ਭਣਿ ਜੋ ਉਤਮ ਸਲੋਕ ਉਧਰਣੰ ਨੈਨ ਨੰਦਨੀ ॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: jeeh bhan jo utam salok udharana(n) nain na(n)danee ||32||
lines.translation: Chanting this most Sublime Word brings salvation and joy to the eyes. ||32||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਹੀਣਸੵ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੰਤ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਸਟਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur ma(n)tr heenasy jo praanee dhriga(n)t janam bhrasatanah ||
lines.translation: That mortal who lacks the Guru's Mantra - cursed and contaminated is his life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂਕਰਹ ਸੂਕਰਹ ਗਰਧਭਹ ਕਾਕਹ ਸਰਪਨਹ ਤੁਲਿ ਖਲਹ ॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: kookarah sookarah garadhabhah kaakah sarapanah tul khalah ||33||
lines.translation: That blockhead is just a dog, a pig, a jackass, a crow, a snake. ||33||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਨੰ ਰਿਦਯੰ ਨਾਮ ਧਾਰਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: charanaarabi(n)d bhajana(n) ridaya(n) naam dhaaranah ||
lines.translation: Whoever contemplates the Lord's Lotus Feet, and enshrines His Name within the heart,
